//: Scopes this directory back to CommonJS. Drupal core's Nightwatch runner discovers and requires these files as CommonJS, but a project root package.json with "type": "module" makes Node treat every .js outside core/ as an ES module, so module.exports fails with 'module is not defined in ES module scope'. Nightwatch only globs *.js, so renaming to .cjs would make the files undiscoverable -- this marker is the fix.
